### a)	Sample Overview {.tabset}


```{r Overview, include=FALSE}
  subgroup = NULL
  convert_and_include_pdf <- function(tool, index,subgroup = NULL, wd, rarefaction) {
    pattern <- sprintf("%s.*\\(%s\\)%s.*\\.pdf$",tool,  rarefaction[index], ifelse(is.null(subgroup), "", paste0(".*", subgroup)))
    input_pdf <- list.files(path = wd, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
    
    if(length(input_pdf) == 0) {
      message("No PDF files found for pattern: ", pattern)
      return()
    }
    
    if (length(input_pdf) > 1) {
    
      message("Multiple PDF files matched pattern: ", pattern, " - using the first: ", basename(input_pdf[1]))
    
    }
    
    base_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(input_pdf[1]))
    output_png <- file.path(dirname(input_pdf[1]), paste0(base_name, ".png"))
    
    image_read_pdf(input_pdf[1], pages = 1) %>%
      image_convert(format = "png") %>%
      image_write(output_png)
    
    include_graphics(output_png)
  }

```


```{r conditional-title_rare, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval=!is.na(imgInfo$rarefaction[1])}

}
```



```{r rare, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=15, fig.width=10, eval=!is.na(imgInfo$rarefaction[1])}
convert_and_include_pdf("1_rarefaction",1, subgroup, dirInfo$image.wd, imgInfo$rarefaction)
```

```{r ASVs1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=length(tabInfo$asvs) >= 1 && !is.null(tabInfo$asvs[[1]])}

if (!is.na(tabInfo$asvs[1])) {
  rownames(tabInfo$asvs[1]) <- NULL

asvTab <- as.data.frame(tabInfo$asvs[1])
seq_num <- seq_len(nrow(asvTab))

# Format the numbers with leading zeros and add the "ASV" prefix
new_rownames <- sprintf("ASV%06d", seq_num)
# Assign the new rownames to the dataframe
rownames(asvTab) <- new_rownames

datatable(asvTab, extensions = 'Buttons', options = list(
  dom = 'frtipB',
  buttons = c('excel','csv'),
  pageLength = 200,
  scrollX = TRUE,
  scrollY = "300px"
))
}

```
